description.narrative: Facilitated economic transformation and improved quality of life in Baiyin City.

40% newly developed industrial land in the SBIZ has been fully committed to applicant enterprises. Progress/Status: Ongoing. About 790 mu of the newly developed industrial land in the SBIZ has been fully committed to applicant enterprises as of Feb 2011. Data Source: BMG statistics reports Actual value:

63 low-efficiency and highly polluting community heating boilers have been domolished Progress/Status: Ongoing. 48 low-efficiency and highly polluting community heating boilers have been demolished. Data Source: Service report by MDHC Actual value:

The district heating service area has expanded by 1.3 million m2 in Baiyin district from the 2006 baseline to benefit 10,000 households including 10% low-income families. Progress/Status: Ongoing. The district heating service area in Baiyin district has expanded by 1.5 million m2 by end 2010. 9200 households benefited including about 3200 (35%) low-income households. Data Source: Service report by Minyue District Heating Company (MDHC) Actual value:

A special heating assistance program has been put in operation before the full operation of the heating system constructed under the Project to ensure low-income families have access to the improved heating service. Progress/Status: Ongoing. The special heating assistance program is in place starting 1st November 2008. Data Source: Service report by MDHC Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N

An urban road transport framework has been established in Baiyin and Pingchun districts to meet their long-term urban development needs up to 2030. Progress/Status: Ongoing. Baiyin Urban Development Master Plan (2001-2020) includes a sector chapter on urban road transport framework for Baiyin district. The Master Plan is being updated to cover up to 2030. Data Source: Baiyin Urban Development Master Plan; BMG statistics reports Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N

Detailed action plans to enforce the national vehicle emission control regulation on the project-built roads have been developed by the concerned project implementing agencies and approved for implementation. Progress/Status: Ongoing. Vehicle emission control has been included in the action plans for energy efficiency and emissions reduction prepared Bayin Government. Data Source: Approval of the action plans by Baiyin Environmental Protection Bureau Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N

The EMS developed for the SBIZ has been adopted and put in full operation. Progress/Status: Ongoing. The EMS is under development. Data Source: Southern Baiyin Environmental Management Committee resolution Base year: 2005 Baseline value: N
